gloss_en: "Ayeh" (אַיֵּה) — the interrogative "Where?", specifically the seeker's cry "Where is the place of His glory?" (אַיֵּה מְקוֹם כְּבוֹדוֹ), the aspect of searching for God's hidden glory from places of concealment/filth, as expounded in Likutey Moharan II:12 (linked to "Where is the lamb for the burnt offering," Gen. 22:7); not the bird אַיָּה (falcon/kite) nor the proper name Ayah
